text:
alex: Heads-up — EU region spike expected Thu 10:00-14:00 from partner promo. Need admit math + headroom so we can decide if we should pre-warm/scale or enforce rejects.

marta: Quick numbers I ran offline: baseline steady RPS for this route ~1400 rps. Partner forecast is +2.6x peak -> ~3640 rps.

jia: What's our per-GPU servicing rate for that route? small seq, avg tokens ~120, with batching & kv cache we get ~22 req/s per GPU today.

marta: Using 22 req/s: GPUs required = ceil(3640/22) = 166 GPUs. We have 120 in EU pool -> shortfall 46 GPUs (38%).

samir: For SLOs — p95 target 120ms, p99 450ms. With current latency headroom, queuing adds ~80ms avg under load. If we want p99<450ms we should keep queueing contribution <50ms. That implies we can't run at >~75% util.

marta: If we cap usable capacity to 75% to protect tail, effective RPS capacity = 120 * 22 * 0.75 = 1980 rps. So admission fraction = 1980 / 3640 = 0.54 -> we'd need to reject ~46% of requests unless we add GPUs or route elsewhere.

alex: Oof. Any cheaper mitigations? Quantized model or smaller variant for partner traffic?

samir: If partner traffic can tolerate 2x quantization we measured ~44 req/s per GPU (same perf test), then GPUs needed = ceil(3640/44) = 83 GPUs. 120 GPUs would be fine. Tradeoff: small quality drop, need opt-in from product.

jia: Another option: temporary cross-region failover to NA (egress cost + ~30ms extra latency). If we shift 40% to NA, EU required drops to ~2184 rps -> EU GPUs needed @22 rps = 100 GPUs, which fits with limited bump. But networking egress caps are 5Gbps on our peering right now; pushing that much may saturate.

marta: Simulation I ran (very small Monte Carlo) — rough Python snippet:

```python
import random
for util in [0.6,0.7,0.8]:
    effective = 120*22*util
    print(util, effective)
```

-> outputs: 1584, 1848, 2112 rps for 60/70/80% util.

alex: Deploy-bot, did we schedule any capacity bump for Thu morning?

deploy-bot: @channel scheduled capacity bump: +30 gpus in eu-west-1 at 09:30 UTC (provision job id: prow-3342). Will attempt soft-attach to existing pool.

marta: With +30 GPUs at same perf: total 150 GPUs -> effective at 75% util = 150*22*0.75 = 2475 rps -> still short vs 3640. Combine +30 GPUs + 40% offload to NA + quantized fallback for 20% would get us into safe zone.

samir: Recommendation: three-pronged plan: (1) Product to approve quantized variant for partner traffic (fallback path) — reduces per-GPU need. (2) Ops to pre-warm +30 GPUs (already scheduled) and verify soft-attach success. (3) Traffic steering: route up to 40% to NA reserve pool if EU latency ok. Also prepare admission control policy: if queue length > 60 requests or observed p95 > 160ms -> start serving quantized or reject at admit=0.7.

jia: I'll run a fuller queueing sim (M/M/c approx + empirical latency curve) and post numbers by EOD.

alex: Great. Action items: marta verify the +30 attach, jia run sim & post detailed numbers, samir draft admit-control policy and config snippet for canary. Product to confirm quality tradeoffs.

samir: quick admit rule snippet: `admit_rate = min(1.0, capacity * 0.72 / observed_load)` and fallback rule: `if p95_latency > 160ms: route_to_quantized(percentage=20)`

alex: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Thu 07:30 UTC for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
